title: Cross tensor relation from local coefficients
statement: For module maps q and q prime, if their values on pulled sections are locally common scalar multiples, then the two cross tensors agree by sheaf separatedness and commutativity of scalars.

source.place: Tags 01N2 (lemma-base-change-map-proj), 01NQ (lemma-relative-proj-base-change), 01NR (lemma-glue-relative-proj-twists), and 01OB (definition-projective-bundle), degree-one quotient normalization and its scalar-extension fraction formula

proof.text: Apply section_ext to the tensor sheaf, use local common coefficients and restriction naturality, and finish with smul_comm.

lean.statement:
theorem cross_tensor_of_local_coefficients_public {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ S)
    (E : S.Modules) {P Q : T.Modules}
    (q : (tensorPullback f).obj E ⟶ P) (q' : (tensorPullback f).obj E ⟶ Q)
    (hlocal : ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : T.Opens) (h : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (x : T), x ∈ W →
      ∃ (Z : T.Opens) (hZW : Z ≤ W) (_ : x ∈ Z)
        (a : Γ(P, Z)) (b : Γ(Q, Z)) (c : Γ(E, U.1) → Γ(T, Z)),
        ∀ t : Γ(E, U.1),
          let s := ((tensorPullback f).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hZW.trans h)).op
            (tensorPullbackSection f E U.1 t)
          q.app Z s = c t • a ∧ q'.app Z s = c t • b) :
    ∀ (U : S.affineOpens) (W : T.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
      (m n : Γ(E, U.1)),
      let m' := ((tensorPullback f).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
        (tensorPullbackSection f E U.1 m)
      let n' := ((tensorPullback f).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
        (tensorPullbackSection f E U.1 n)
      tmulSection (q.app W.1 m') (q'.app W.1 n') =
        tmulSection (q.app W.1 n') (q'.app W.1 m')
